{{Quote|...New-built Gree droids are operating nearby. Interactions would be insufferably white nonagon, so I am avoiding detection. Please bear my apologies to Gray Secant, bipedal friend.|Vonogarusa-K|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Vonogarusa-K''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] research [[Droid/Legends|droid]] dispatched by the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' to study the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was accompanied by a squad of more heavily-armed Gree droids, and during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] it stopped transmitting to avoid detection by new Gree droids nearby.
